column1: # launcher-families fixed in the launcher, not in C:
#   [SMP:rload] (vk_platform.c:581) is gated by smp_loadStats (default 1) alone -> QUIET arm now sets smp_loadStats=0, DIAG arm smp_loadStats=1
#   vk_2dCover stays 2 in both arms: the family is PROBE_On && vk_2dCover, so qa_probe 0 already silences it
# qa_probe=0 is the master instrument switch (qcommon/qa_probe.h: "0 silences
# every probe family").  After this round a QUIET boot can still print, and each
#   VK:guard            VK_Guard_Hit - reached only on a non-VK_SUCCESS result
#   VK:valid            the validation layer's own findings (needs r_vkValidate=1,
#                       which QUIET sets to 0, so it cannot fire at all)
#   VK:firstlight fail  a bring-up stage failed
#   VK:guard site=sentinel  the PRIOR boot crashed (marker present)
#   VK:guard site=safe-mode explicit r_vkSafeMode or the prior-crash marker
#   VK:guard site=device    vkCreateDevice refused the descriptor-indexing chain
#   VK:guard site=sync      the render thread refused to spawn (running serial)
#   VK:guard site=instance  validation requested but the layer is absent
#   VK:smp walk-thread-gone the SMP handoff is broken, the frame walks inline
#          retire-pass      the walk refused or abandoned work
#   VK:ring frame drops>0||refused>0  the vertex ring lost geometry
#   VK:fe gate refused=1   the scene pools refused an add (polys or entities dropped)
#   VK:texture         a format the device cannot hold fell back to rgba8
#   VK:pcache foreign  an on-disk pipeline cache was rejected
#   VK:shade resolved<total  a shader family did not resolve
#   VK:perm            a permutation key with no SPIR-V (the draw is lost)
#   [VK:drop]          a refused bind loses the draw
#   VK:wave create/upload/publish-failed  the wave LUT did not land
#   [VK:skeldrop]/[VK:skelbail]  a skeleton surface did not draw / the bone arena
#   PRINT_WARNING/PRINT_ERROR arms (load failures, allocation refusals) are the
#   engine's own fault channel and were never gated.
# Everything else in the census is behind R_ProbeStatsOn()/PROBE_On(), behind its
# own family cvar that QUIET sets to 0 (d2_stallStats, and now smp_loadStats), or
# unreachable in QUIET for the reason in its row.
